contexts.text: In the exemption of my hands I have done this () = from the affection of truth, and thus from every faculty... In the Original Language exemption is expressed by a word which also means cleanness and purity... Exempt or clean or pure hands, which are predicated of truths, do not exist unless there is good in the truths, that is, unless there is the affection of truth...
That he should render the spiritual truth of doctrine exempt from the Rational. Signified. AC 2538.
